caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic pitcher, cup, or mug with a cylindrical body and a flared rim at the top. The exterior of the vessel is colored in various shades of brown, suggesting a copper or brass material, and features subtle shading and texture to indicate the reflective and somewhat tarnished surface of the metal. The inside of the cup is a light grayish-blue, indicating a different metal or lining. The cup has a large, curved handle attached to the side with visible rivets or fasteners at the top and bottom. The cup sits on a slightly raised, rounded base. The background is plain and off-white, and there is minimal surface shading beneath the cup. At the bottom of the drawing, there are hand-written elements: “EXACT SIZE” to the left, “LEFT” below the cup, and “W.H. SHORTLIFF” at the lower right corner.
title: Copper Measuring Cup
